aka.zh: 桂柳高速公路（桂林至柳州段）
柳南高速公路（柳州至南宁段）

tagline.en: From the Fujian coast across Jiangxi and Hunan to Guilin and Nanning, finished when a single provincial toll gate opened in 2015
tagline.zh: 自福建沿海横穿江西、湖南，经桂林抵南宁；2015 年一处省界收费站开通，全线才算贯通

start.en: Nanning East toll station on Minzu Avenue, Qingxiu District, Nanning, Guangxi, where the road runs on as G75 Lanzhou–Haikou
start.zh: 广西壮族自治区南宁市青秀区南宁东收费站，接民族大道，顺接 G75 兰海高速

end.en: Jinjiang junction with G15 Shenyang–Haikou Expressway, Jinjiang, Quanzhou, Fujian — kilometre 0
end.zh: 福建省泉州市晋江市晋江枢纽，接 G15 沈海高速——零公里点

en: G72 is one of the east–west lines of the national expressway network. It leaves the coast at Quanzhou, climbs inland through Yongchun, Datian and Yong'an in the Fujian hills, crosses into Jiangxi at Shicheng and runs by Ningdu, Xingguo, Taihe and Yongxin to the Hunan border at Jiehualong, then through Chaling and You county to Hengyang, west to Qiyang and Yongzhou, and into Guangxi at Huangshahe. In Guangxi it runs by Quanzhou county and Xing'an to Guilin, south to Liuzhou and Laibin, and on to Nanning.

It is pieced together from older provincial roads and shares long stretches with other national routes: with G4 Beijing–Hong Kong–Macau through Hengyang, with G76 Xiamen–Chengdu from Quanzhou county to Guilin, with G78 Shantou–Kunming around Liuzhou, and with G80 Guangzhou–Kunming from Liujing into Nanning. The planned length, the figure used when it was completed, is 1,635 km. Chinese Wikipedia's per-province chainage — 328 km in Fujian, 310 in Jiangxi, 327 in Hunan and 522 in Guangxi — adds up to about 1,488 km, and Baidu Baike gives 1,471.42 km from 2017 Ministry of Transport data. The atlas draws the route as one long line with a separate fragment about a mile long near Laibin; this page is about the whole route.
zh: G72 是国家高速公路网的东西横线之一。它从泉州离开海岸，向内陆爬升，经福建山区的永春、大田、永安，在石城进入江西，经宁都、兴国、泰和、永新抵湘赣界界化垄；再经茶陵、攸县到衡阳，西行经祁阳、永州，在黄沙河进入广西。广西境内经全州、兴安至桂林，南下柳州、来宾，终至南宁。

它由早年的各省路段拼接而成，并与多条国家高速长距离共线：衡阳一带与 G4 京港澳高速共线，全州至桂林与 G76 厦蓉高速共线，柳州一带与 G78 汕昆高速共线，六景至南宁与 G80 广昆高速共线。规划全长 1,635 公里，也是全线贯通时报道采用的数字。中文维基百科所列分省里程——福建 328 公里、江西 310 公里、湖南 327 公里、广西 522 公里——合计约 1,488 公里；百度百科引交通运输部 2017 年数据作 1,471.42 公里。图集将这条路画成一条长线，另在来宾附近有一段约一英里的零碎线段；本页介绍的是全线。

en: The oldest piece is the 138.46 km Guilin–Liuzhou expressway, Guangxi's first, built in 1993–1997 as four lanes on a 24.5 m roadbed for 80 to 100 km/h. It runs close beside the Hunan–Guangxi railway and was tested during construction by severe floods in 1994 and 1996. Between 2021 and 2023 its 100.8 km from Guilin West to Luzhai North were rebuilt to eight lanes for 120 km/h, mostly by widening on both sides, with 68 bridges and 3 tunnels; with the Liuzhou–Nanning road also at eight lanes, Guilin to Nanning is now eight lanes throughout.

Further east the hills make the work heavier. Hunan's Chaling–Hengyang section has 26 large bridges, 4 tunnels and 667 culverts and underpasses; the Hengyang–Zaomupu section 4 extra-large and 11 large bridges and 844 culverts. On the Ji'an–Lianhua section in Jiangxi, the builders reported karst caves under 13 sections of roadbed, the largest as tall as a seven-storey building, and treated each pile foundation that met one individually.
zh: 最早的一段是 138.46 公里的桂柳高速公路，也是广西第一条高速公路，1993—1997 年建成，双向四车道，路基宽 24.5 米，设计时速 80 至 100 公里。它与湘桂铁路基本重合，施工期间经受了 1994、1996 年两次特大洪灾的考验。2021 至 2023 年，桂林西至鹿寨北的 100.8 公里改扩建为八车道，设计时速 120 公里，以两侧拼接为主，全线桥梁 68 座、隧道 3 座；加上已扩建为八车道的柳南高速，桂林至南宁现已全程双向八车道。
往东去，山地使工程更为繁重。湖南茶衡段有大桥 26 座、隧道 4 座、涵洞与通道 667 道；衡枣段有特大桥 4 座、大桥 11 座、涵洞 844 道。江西吉莲段建设方称，有 13 处路基下发现溶洞，最大的空腔有七层楼高，凡遇溶洞的桩基都单独制订处理方案。

en: The Guangxi end came first: Guilin–Liuzhou opened on 1 May 1997, and Liuzhou–Nanning in two parts, to Binyang on 8 December 1998 and on to Nanning on 1 October 1999. Hunan's Hengyang–Zaomupu section opened on 26 December 2003. The middle was filled in over the next decade: Huangshahe–Quanzhou in Guangxi in December 2004, Quanzhou–Xing'an on 30 November 2008, Quanzhou–Sanming in Fujian on 15 March 2009, Chaling–Hengyang on 26 December 2009, Shicheng–Ji'an in Jiangxi on 16 September 2010 and Yong'an–Ninghua in Fujian on 16 December 2011.

Xing'an–Guilin opened in April 2013. Its opening let three toll barriers on the main line around Guilin be removed, the last such barriers inside Guangxi, and the regional press described it as completing G72 in Guangxi and giving Nanning an expressway all the way to Beijing.

The last gap was on the Hunan–Jiangxi border. Hunan's Jiehualong–Chaling section was finished at the end of 2013, but the Jiangxi road it was to meet was not, and drivers had to leave at Guangming and take National Road 320 for about 40 km. Jiangxi opened the last part of Ji'an–Lianhua on 9 January 2015, and on 16 January the two border toll stations, Gaolong and Jiehualong, opened together. Changsha Evening News and Rednet reported the 1,635 km route complete that day.
zh: 广西一端最早建成：桂柳高速 1997 年 5 月 1 日通车；柳南高速分两段，柳州至宾阳段 1998 年 12 月 8 日、宾阳至南宁段 1999 年 10 月 1 日通车。湖南衡枣段 2003 年 12 月 26 日通车。此后十年间中段陆续补齐：广西全州至黄沙河段 2004 年 12 月、全州至兴安段 2008 年 11 月 30 日，福建泉三高速 2009 年 3 月 15 日，湖南茶衡段 2009 年 12 月 26 日，江西石吉高速 2010 年 9 月 16 日，福建永宁高速 2011 年 12 月 16 日相继通车。
兴安至桂林段 2013 年 4 月通车。随之撤销了桂林周边主线上的三个收费站——广西境内最后的主线收费站（省界站除外）；当地媒体称，泉南高速广西段由此完全贯通，南宁至北京实现全程高速。
最后的缺口在湘赣省界。湖南界化垄至茶陵段 2013 年底建成，但江西境内对接路段未通，车辆须在光明收费站下高速，绕行 320 国道约 40 公里。江西吉莲高速最后一段于 2015 年 1 月 9 日通车；1 月 16 日，高陇、界化垄两个省界收费站同步开通。长沙晚报和红网当日报道，全长 1,635 公里的泉南高速全线贯通。

en: No total has been published; the road was financed province by province and section by section from 1993 to 2015. Section figures range from ¥1.86 billion for Guilin–Liuzhou in the 1990s — about ¥13.4 million a kilometre, then described as the cheapest mountain expressway in the country — to ¥10.083 billion for the 191 km Shicheng–Ji'an section in Jiangxi.

Funding is known only for some sections. Quanzhou–Xing'an was invested in by China Railway Southwest Investment together with the Guangxi expressway administration; Xing'an–Guilin, which cost ¥3.13 billion, was given a 29-year toll period by the regional government. The eight-lane rebuilding of Guilin–Liuzhou, at ¥16.03 billion, was invested by Guangxi Communications Investment Group — more than eight times the cost of the original road.
zh: 全线没有公开的总造价；它在 1993 至 2015 年间由各省区分段筹资修建。已公开的分段数字，从 1990 年代桂柳高速的 18.6 亿元——平均每公里约 1,340 万元，当时被称为全国山区高速公路造价最低——到江西石吉段 191 公里的 100.83 亿元不等。
出资方只有部分路段可查。全州至兴安段由中铁西南投资公司与广西高速公路管理局投资兴建；兴安至桂林段实际投资 31.3 亿元，自治区政府核定收费期限 29 年。桂柳高速八车道改扩建由广西交通投资集团投资，总投资 160.3 亿元——是原路造价的八倍多。

en: Widening continues at both ends. In Fujian, the 21.8 km from Yongchun to Tangcheng was rebuilt with the Shaxian–Xiamen expressway from 2020. In Guangxi, the four-lane stretch from Huangshahe through Quanzhou county and Xing'an to Guilin is planned for eight lanes in four projects; feasibility studies for the Huangshahe–Quanzhou and Lingchuan–Lingui parts were reviewed in May 2026.
zh: 两端的扩容仍在进行。福建永春互通至汤城枢纽 21.8 公里自 2020 年起与沙厦高速一并改扩建。广西境内，黄沙河经全州、兴安至桂林的四车道路段计划分四个项目扩建为八车道；其中黄沙河至全州段、灵川至临桂段的工程可行性研究报告于 2026 年 5 月通过评估。

why.en: No route-wide figure is published. G72 was built by four provinces as separately financed sections between 1993 and 2015, each accounted for on its own; sourced section costs are listed below.
why.zh: 未公布全线总造价。G72 由四省区在 1993 至 2015 年间分段筹资建设、分别核算；有来源的分段造价列于下方。

value.en: Partial: Quanzhou–Xing'an by China Railway Southwest Investment and the Guangxi expressway administration; the Guilin–Liuzhou eight-lane rebuild by Guangxi Communications Investment Group; Xing'an–Guilin repaid from tolls over 29 years. Who paid for the Fujian, Jiangxi and Hunan sections has not been found.
value.zh: 部分可查：全州至兴安段由中铁西南投资公司与广西高速公路管理局投资；桂柳八车道改扩建由广西交通投资集团投资；兴安至桂林段以 29 年通行费还贷。福建、江西、湖南各段出资方未查到。

figures.source: Nanguo Morning Post via gxnews.com.cn, November 2008; Nanning News, 10 April 2013, archived; Guangxi News, 26 December 2023

value.zh: 18.6 亿元，平均每公里约 1,340 万元

figures.source: Chinese Wikipedia, 桂林—柳州高速公路
People's Daily Overseas Edition, 27 December 2023; Guangxi News, 26 December 2023

value.en: Hengyang–Zaomupu, 186.1 km: ¥5.125 billion (2000–2003). Chaling–Hengyang: ¥4.91 billion budgeted for the 114.2 km Hengyang–Yanling project, part of which is another route (2005–2009). Jiehualong–Chaling, 45.2 km: ¥3.016 billion budgeted (2009–2013).

figures.source: Chinese Wikipedia, 泉州—南宁高速公路, citing Hunan provincial and local sources now offline

value.en: Shicheng–Ji'an, 190.7 km: ¥10.083 billion total investment, including ¥418 million on environmental protection (2008–2010). Ji'an–Lianhua, 106.7 km: ¥5.04 billion in the approved feasibility study (2010–2015); final cost not found.
value.zh: 石吉段 190.7 公里总投资 100.83 亿元，其中环保投资 4.18 亿元（2008—2010）；吉莲段 106.7 公里工可批复 50.4 亿元（2010—2015），最终造价未查到。

figures.source: Ministry of Environmental Protection completion-acceptance letter for Shicheng–Ji'an, as reproduced by o771.cn; Baike.com, 吉莲高速公路

value.en: Quanzhou–Xing'an, 61.5 km: ¥1.722 billion (2006–2008). Xing'an–Guilin, 53.4 km: ¥3.13 billion actual (2009–2013).

figures.source: Nanguo Morning Post via gxnews.com.cn, November 2008; Nanning News, 10 April 2013, archived

value.en: 1,635 km as planned and as reported on completion; about 1,488 km by Chinese Wikipedia's provincial chainage; 1,471.42 km in Baidu Baike from 2017 Ministry of Transport data
value.zh: 规划及贯通报道均作 1,635 公里；按中文维基百科分省里程约 1,488 公里；百度百科引交通运输部 2017 年数据作 1,471.42 公里

figures.source: Rednet and Changsha Evening News, 16–18 January 2015; Chinese Wikipedia, 泉州—南宁高速公路; Baidu Baike, 泉州—南宁高速公路

timeline.en: Work on the Guilin–Liuzhou expressway begins on 5 October.
timeline.zh: 10 月 5 日，桂柳高速公路动工。

timeline.en: Guilin–Liuzhou, Guangxi's first expressway, opens on 1 May.
timeline.zh: 5 月 1 日，广西第一条高速公路桂柳高速通车。
10 月 1 日，柳南高速全线通车。

timeline.en: Hunan's Hengyang–Zaomupu section opens on 26 December.
timeline.zh: 12 月 26 日，湖南衡枣段通车。

timeline.en: Quanzhou–Sanming in Fujian opens on 15 March; Chaling–Hengyang on 26 December.
timeline.zh: 3 月 15 日，福建泉三高速全线通车；12 月 26 日，茶衡段通车。

timeline.en: Shicheng–Ji'an in Jiangxi opens on 16 September.
timeline.zh: 9 月 16 日，江西石吉高速通车。

timeline.en: Yong'an–Ninghua in Fujian opens on 16 December.
timeline.zh: 12 月 16 日，福建永宁高速通车。

timeline.en: Xing'an–Guilin opens in April, completing the Guangxi section; Hunan's Jiehualong–Chaling section is finished on 30 December.
timeline.zh: 4 月，兴桂高速通车，广西段贯通；12 月 30 日，湖南垄茶段建成。

timeline.en: The Gaolong and Jiehualong border toll stations open on 16 January, completing the route.
timeline.zh: 1 月 16 日，高陇、界化垄省界收费站同步开通，泉南高速全线贯通。

timeline.en: Guilin–Liuzhou reopens at eight lanes on 26 December.
timeline.zh: 12 月 26 日，桂柳高速八车道改扩建工程建成通车。
